note: Anonymous local shopping scope. Account, source cart, order and payment states are intentionally excluded.

deferred.source-cart-checkout: Source-side cart addition and checkout were not authorized.
deferred.source-auth: Login, OTP and account-only evidence were not authorized and credentials were unavailable.
deferred.payment-order: Payment and order submission are not part of the candidate; checkout stops at review.

visual_excluded.home.mobile: No directly captured styled mobile source artifact.
visual_excluded.search: Approved-origin capture blocked source CSS and product media, so structural and functional evidence is used.
visual_excluded.product: Source product detail could not be safely acquired during the bounded anonymous walk.

states_out_of_scope.account-auth: Credentials, login, registration and recovery are outside authority.
states_out_of_scope.orders-returns: Orders, tracking, cancellation, returns and refunds require authenticated/source mutation evidence.
states_out_of_scope.promo-address-payment: Gift cards, address book, promotion redemption and payment are excluded.
